# `oaap app bulk`

update, promote or rebuild everything that is due, one after another, stopping at the first failure.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app bulk {plan,start,run,stop,list} [rest ...]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `verb` | (one of `plan`, `start`, `run`, `stop`, `list`) |
| `rest` | -- |
